cells.gaps: No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. The authorities do not recognise UNHCR's documents, and most Sudanese refugees in the east are undocumented.
cells.note: Stage 3: UNHCR had registered 108,455 refugees and asylum-seekers by 2025 and issued them certificates. Nothing says refugees may use SIM cards, accounts or digital ID, so not 4.
